remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 1850 vintage farmhouse colonial in the sought-after Cranbury neighborhood. Step into a spacious foyer with impressively high ceilings that set the tone for this charming home. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths, this residence includes a convenient first-floor bedroom, perfect for guests or in-laws. Cozy up by one of the three fireplaces, or relaxing with a book in the sunroom.   Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms and a generously sized bathroom. The walk-up attic offers endless potential for additional living space or storage.  The mudroom leads you to a picturesque backyard retreat. With a freshly painted exterior, this home boasts modern updates, including a new septic system installed last year, a new driveway, and a newer boiler. The professionally landscaped grounds feature a detached 2-car garage-ideal for handymen, artists, or collectors-complete with a heated office and a full loft that was built in 1989. Additional outdoor highlights include a separate storage shed, a chicken coop, and mature fruit trees bearing peaches and plums. The fenced-in yard and extra-large patio provide the perfect setting for relaxation or entertaining.  Don't miss your chance to explore this pristine, move-in-ready home!
